name: Dynasties of the Deep
description: Underwater politics.|The sea cucumber, a former antagonist, is actually Commander Cucumis of the Seaweed Bloc. He needs your help to strengthen ties with the other underwater factions and possibly uncover a conspiracy.

text: Ah, it's you again. Our previous encounter was... unfortunate.
I need an outsider's help, someone uninvolved in our politics.
Three other blocs control these waters with me. Can you act as my envoy?
completedText: Meet with representatives of the three blocs.

text: Greetings, envoy of Commander Cucumis. I am Coral of the Reef Bloc.
A clandestine group opposes the unity of our blocs.
Find out who they are and I shall consider an alliance.
I am Kelp of the Tidal Bloc. Cucumis and I have our differences.
Yet, a bigger threat emerges from the abyss.
Retrieve a dark pearl from the abyss, and I'll hear your plea.
completedText: Retrieve the dark pearl from the abyss.

text: Oh, hello! I'm Bubbles of the Bubble Bloc.
A secret pact between two blocs might lead to war.
Discover which blocs, and I shall align with Commander Cucumis.
completedText: Discover the blocs involved in the secret pact.

text: You've uncovered our plan! Yet, we only wish for equal power among blocs.
Convince the commander to call a council, where all voices are heard, and conflict will cease.
completedText: Return to Commander Cucumis with the information.

text: A council, you say? I've been blind, letting power dictate our paths.
Let's bring unity to our underwater world. Here's a reward for your invaluable aid.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have diplomatically navigated the @crimson@Dynasties of the Deep@green@. Commander Cucumis awards you with the Command Seal and 5000 gold!
